title: Stream Summary and Key Claims
originalTitle: 【MELATONIN】 Hi I Just Woke Up Goodnight
lead: The character successfully completed the initial attempt despite distractions.
summaryOneLine: The character successfully completed the initial attempt despite distractions.
articleBodyHtml:
Initial Attempt Success

The character successfully completed the initial attempt despite distractions.

Normal Mode Performance

The character did not achieve the desired score in the normal mode.

Confidence in Hard Mode

The character expresses confidence in their ability to succeed in the hard mode.

Discord Usage and Rhythm Game

Someone was using a Discord message and a Discord notification.

They are playing a rhythm game and attempting to redo sections.

They are trying to be accurate.

They need to be on time for the game.

Previous Attempts and Preparation

They've had previous attempts that were too early and it's important to do work beforehand.

Importance of Meeting Deadlines

Meeting deadlines is important.

Aiming for Three Stars

They are aiming for three stars and consider it achievable.

It's important to get work done early.

Notes and Swipe Direction

The notes are important for determining the swipe direction.

Discussion on Rooms and Robots

The characters are discussing rooms and robots.

Increasing Difficulty

The difficulty level is increasing.

The initial level was easy.

Admiration for Creator

The speaker admires the creator's ingenuity (sasuga).

Avoiding Exercise

The speaker avoids thinking about exercise.

Starting the Challenge

The speaker begins the challenging task.

The speaker instructs to focus on patterns and repeat them.

Stream Conclusion

The stream ended with three stars.

The streamer successfully completed another night of streaming.

The streamer was on the couch during the stream.

There was an alarm sound.

The streamer questioned whether the alarm or a microwave was making a sound.

The streamer was unable to distinguish between the alarm and the microwave.

It was the third night of the stream.

The streamer expressed surprise.

relatedStreams.title: 「後で戻る」を攻略に組み込む　Inaの『Clair Obscur: Expedition 33』
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 撤退を諦めとして扱わず、課題を保留リストへ移しながら学習を継続するInaの判断を読める

relatedStreams.title: Inaの休暇前雑談　Kingdom Hearts IVへの驚きから音楽、食事、Bibooとの外出まで
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: Inaが最近気になったゲームと音楽、生活の工夫、Bibooとの外出を落ち着いたテンポで振り返る休暇前雑談です。

relatedStreams.title: InaのFilm of the Year予想は「Reze」　Anime of the YearはMy Hero Academiaへ
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 3時間超の同時視聴から、最後の大きな2部門を前にInaがどの作品へ心が傾いていたか、その理由とともに短く追える

relatedStreams.title: Ninomae Ina'nisが「夏酒Season 2」で選んだ洋梨　醸造と雨のvisualを結んだPR配信
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 配信時点の発表と現在変わり得る販売条件を分離し、PR内容を安全に記録する

relatedStreams.title: 曲ごとに違う難しさを、一つの物語へ束ねる　Ina初EP制作談
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 楽曲紹介を感想の列挙にせず、一つのEPをつなぐ制作判断と、次の企画がまだ未確定な地点まで読める

relatedStreams.title: Product Review and Fan Interaction Discussion
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: The design of the product has been positively received, with users commenting on its aesthetic appeal and practicality for desk use. One user noted, 'That's very nice,' while another added, 'That's good for like on desk.' These comments indicate that the product is not only visually appealing but also functional in a typical workspace setting.
